state:
Goal `core-test-2-2` is **not** met. Ten members of the stage 2 dossier have every proof: `assertNull`,
`assertSame`, `assertThrows`, `sentSocket`, `double`, `partial`, `sentHttp`, `tlsSession`, `request` and
`serverUrl`. Three still owe proofs (see the next group). `bun nv proofs --verify --only <the check's argv
list>` says what is owed.

`nvs test` now puts the tree's configuration snapshot on the suite's context
(`crates/nvs-cli/src/runner.rs`, pinned by `crates/nvs-cli/tests/test_grants.rs`), so a `[capabilities]`
grant reaches a test. Before that fix every grant was denied under `nvs test`.

Any change to `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/test.rs` makes every `Core\Test` bench stale, so the session that lands
the last proofs runs `bun nv proofs --record-perf --only <every Core\Test member>` after its verify, and the
stage 1 check then passes again.

items.text: **`Core\Test::scriptAnswers`, `Core\Test::expectFailure` and `Core\Test::assertTrue`** — about.md, three examples, attack, bench and a Rust `covers:` test each (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`); registry rows at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/test.rs:715` and `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/test.rs:690`. Model: the `request` proofs in `docs/examples/core/Test/request/` and its test `request_returns_the_units_status_and_bytes_and_throws_with_no_unit`. An example's `#[Test]` method is checked by hand with `nvs test` (playbook, *Writing a test case*).

**Re-measure every `Core\Test` bench** after the last Rust change, then run both dossier checks in `data/goals/core-test-2-2.json` (`rule:testing/member-perf-ledger`); the ledger is `docs/perf/members.ndjson`, and `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/test.rs:570` is the class whose members it covers.

backlog: `Core\Test::request` accepts a path that is empty, has no `/`, or contains a zero byte or a new line, and header names that are empty or contain a new line. Nothing is serialised, so nothing is injected; a real door refuses all of these. Owner if it matters: `rule:testing/in-process-request`.
